judged_text: The team-permission check uses AND instead of OR: `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))` requires the user to be BOTH admin and owner, so a plain team admin (not owner) is correctly denied but a team owner who is not an admin is also denied, and neither can ever satisfy the intended 'admin or owner' gate. Team admins/owners who are not the booking organizer or attendee get FORBIDDEN for an operation the design intends them to perform; conversely the gate as written is stricter than specified and the boolean logic contradicts the variable name isTeamAdminOrOwner.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both an admin and an owner. That contradicts the variable name and will incorrectly deny access to users who are only one of those roles (e.g., a team admin but not owner, or an owner but not admin) unless they also satisfy `isOrganizer` or `isAttendee`. The subsequent gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN` makes this an observable permission bug.
